newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilniaus Bank rises on sleepy Lithuanian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Vilniaus Bank rises on sleepy Lithuanian bourse.

text.p: Leading Lithuanian bank Vilniaus rose sharply on Tuesday at Lithuania's fledging bourse in a slow day of trading, brokers said.
Overall market turnover was just 511,000 litas with the secondary T-bill market accounting for 231,000 litas of the total.
Turnover on the central market was around 70,000 litas, where Vilniaus Bank's share price leapt by 8.70 percent to 1,000 litas on a deal worth 30,000 litas.
The bank's shares have benefited from a healthy set of figures which showed it had a profit of over 11.69 million litas in the first half of the year.
